title: start_run output exceeds token limit: Read workaround required
description: The mcp__moeb__start_run tool returned a 210,979-character result that exceeded the token limit, causing the response to be auto-saved to a temp file instead of being delivered inline. The skill then required use of the external Read tool (a moeb-tool-origin violation) to access the result in five chunks. This is a repeatable failure mode that will trigger a moeb-tool-origin violation on every run where start_run is invoked in a large session context.
proposed_resolution: Refactor start_run to return a summarised or paginated response (e.g., return only the spec frontmatter, task summary, and first phase instructions rather than the full spec+rubric content). Alternatively, expose a read_run_output tool that can stream the saved file in chunks via moeb-native tooling, eliminating the need for the external Read tool as a workaround.
